pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 31
   C. 27
   D. 17

3. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 16
   C. 22
   D. 32

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

6. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 10
   C. 40.5
   D. 9

7. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

9. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

12. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x < 5
   D. x > 5

13. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

14. Solve for x: x + 6 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 6

15. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 1

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

17. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

18. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

19. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 5

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 75
   C. 30
   D. 40

21. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

23. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

24. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 48

25. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

26. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 1
   C. 21
   D. 20

27. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

28. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 9

29. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

30. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 12
